findings.source_quote:
The true thy chartered freemen are
  of every age and clime:
findings.suggested_fix: Replace or remove the visible soft-hyphen in "verbrief­ten" (it appears as a discretionary hyphen). Use "verbriefte Freien" without the hyphenation for normal contemporary German typography.
findings.translation_quote:
Die wahren sind deine verbrief­ten Freien
  aus jeder Zeit und jedem Land:

findings.suggested_fix: Consider rendering "one working band" as "eine arbeitende Schar" or "eine arbeitende Schar/Truppe" if you want a more idiomatic, poetic German equivalent for "band" in the sense of a group. "ein arbeitender Bund" is comprehensible but a little prosaic for poetry.
